brief:
Palestinians in Gaza held burial ceremonies for the remains of 100 people recovered from destroyed buildings, Al Jazeera English reported. The recovery operation represents an ongoing effort to locate and identify victims across the territory following widespread destruction of residential and civilian infrastructure.

Aid workers and local residents have continued searching through collapsed structures and damaged buildings for additional remains. Thousands more bodies are believed to remain buried beneath the rubble, according to the report, as recovery efforts persist across multiple sites in Gaza.
dek: The remains of thousands more people are believed to be buried under destroyed and damaged buildings in Gaza.
title: Gaza Palestinians bury 100 bodies recovered from rubble
